findings.evidence: The exact envelope omitted mandatory projection_id and creation ambiguously deleted a required field from an incomplete record.
findings.required_change: Use one authoritative envelope and separate exact creation and verification algorithms.
findings.verification: Identity and self-digest vectors reproduce candidate, source, projection, envelope and digest.

findings.evidence: Keyword ordering and the exact error-result schema remained unspecified.
findings.required_change: Define deterministic error selection and an exact canonical result/error record.
findings.verification: Multiple failures and permuted inputs produce byte-identical records.

findings.evidence: Cost unit counts, coefficient domains, arithmetic and temporary lifetimes were not executable across implementations.
findings.required_change: Define an exact CostSchedule schema, events, counts, ordering, arithmetic and abstract temporary lifetimes.
findings.verification: Independent charge traces and boundary outcomes match; invalid schedules reject before input.
